steps.say: On a grid, move right or left first. Then move up or down.

figure.alt: A grid. S is at 1 across and 1 up. A is at 4 across and 3 up.

steps.say: Clockwise is the way clock hands move. A quarter turn clockwise goes from 12 to 3.

figure.alt: A clock. The long minute hand points to 3. The short hour hand is between 12 and 1.

steps.say: A half turn makes you face the opposite way.
Anticlockwise is the other way. A quarter turn anticlockwise goes from 12 to 9.
4 quarter turns make a full turn.

check.prompt: The long hand points to 3. It makes a half turn. Where does it point now?

figure.alt: A clock. The long minute hand points to 3. The short hour hand is between 12 and 1.

hints: A half turn points the opposite way.
Opposite 3 on a clock is straight across.
Start at 3. Turn halfway round the clock.
check.explanation: A half turn from 3 points to 9, on the opposite side of the clock.

options.why: 6 is a quarter turn clockwise from 3.
12 is a quarter turn anticlockwise from 3.

check.prompt: How many quarter turns make a full turn?
hints: A quarter turn is one of 4 equal turns.
Use a clock: 12 to 3 is one quarter turn.
Count the quarter turns from 12 all the way back to 12.
check.explanation: 12 to 3, 3 to 6, 6 to 9 and 9 to 12 make 4 quarter turns.
